topic: Day 101 — reel — You heal by no longer being run by it, not by forgetting it
text:
Healed isn't
forgetting.
It's no longer
being [run] by it.
caption:
The goal was never erasing the memory. The marker is whether it still quietly decides what you do today.

Follow for one of these a day.
